mapper.insert: insert into ai_video_story_bible (project_id, chapter_id, version_no, status, world_setting, timeline_json, relationship_json, immutable_facts_json, content_json, source_reference_json, model_name, prompt_version, create_by, create_time) values (#{projectId}, #{chapterId}, #{versionNo}, #{status}, #{worldSetting}, #{timelineJson}, #{relationshipJson}, #{immutableFactsJson}, #{contentJson}, #{sourceReferenceJson}, #{modelName}, #{promptVersion}, #{createBy}, now())
mapper.select: select bible_id, project_id, chapter_id, version_no, status, content_json from ai_video_story_bible where chapter_id = #{chapterId} and del_flag = '0' order by version_no desc limit 1
